messages:
sara-cs: Customer (AcmePayments) just escalated — they hit a hard failure after the recent key-wrap change. They’re seeing ERR_KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED across several services. They want ETA for CVE-2026-12345 patch and a mitigation plan. :rotating_light:

amy-support: Logged with customer. They reported this started after our 2026-03-04 key-wrap rollout. Customer provided sample request id: rq_8f3b2a and stack trace. Asking for repro steps we can run in staging.

miguel-eng-security: CVE-2026-12345 = key-wrap edge case in HSM adapter when asymmetric wrapping falls back incorrectly. Prioritizing. Need HSM firmware + keystore metadata from Acme (key version, wrap algorithm). Also want audit log slice for 2026-03-04 00:00-04:00 UTC.

amy-support: Pasted log snippet from customer:```
2026-03-04T01:23:14Z ERROR api.gateway decrypt failed (rq_8f3b2a) ERR_KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED: wrap_unwrap_error: 0x3f
2026-03-04T01:23:14Z INFO retrying with fallback key
2026-03-04T01:23:15Z ERROR service.payments payout failed: invalid ciphertext
```

sara-cs: Customer attached a minimal repro curl that hits our hosted API and then shows 500s when the key version is bumped. They also flagged an audit gap — several wrap events are missing a corresponding audit record.

lucas-eng-runtime: I can reproduce in our staging with the same keystore version. Quick repro steps I ran:```
# set env to staging keystore
export REDWOOD_ENV=staging
# simulate request
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer test" -d '{"payload":"...","key_version":7}' https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/decrypt
```

lucas-eng-runtime: When key_version >=7, HSM adapter returns an unwrap error 0x3f in our logs. Looks like the adapter incorrectly treats a sentinel flag as a permanent failure instead of doing a soft-fallback.

miguel-eng-security: Confirmed. If HSM firmware >= 3.2.1 + adapter v2.4.0 present, this path triggers. This explains why only some customers (on that HSM setup) see it.

jon-oncall: Can we do a safety rollback for the adapter patch? What’s the customer-facing window we can promise?

lucas-eng-runtime: We have a branch (runtime/keystore-rollback-20260304) that reverts the strict-failure change. I can promote a canary in us-east-1 within 30m, full rollback ~2 hours if canary looks good.

olivia-devex: Need to coordinate docs and notify customers who subscribed to audit logs. Also patch notes + migration guide for rekeying.

miguel-eng-security: Short-term mitigation options for Acme: 1) rekey to key_version 6 (if acceptable) 2) route their vault requests to a region with older firmware 3) enable software-wrap fallback (higher latency/cost but avoids HSM unwrap path).

amy-support: Acme prefers not to rekey tonight. They asked for a temporary server-side mitigation we can apply without changing their keys.

lucas-eng-runtime: We can enable software-wrap fallback on their tenant flag (tenant_override: allow_software_wrap=true). That will avoid HSM unwrap calls for new requests. Performance hit but minimal downtime. I can flip it in 15m after approvals.

miguel-eng-security: Also we should rotate audit log retention to include full wrap/unwrap traces for their tenant for postmortem. I'll trigger higher verbosity for that tenant.

jon-oncall: My plan: 1) approve tenant override to software-wrap for Acme now. 2) promote runtime/keystore-rollback canary in us-east-1. 3) if canary green in 30m, roll to other regions. 4) schedule CVE patch (adapter fix + integration test) for 24-48h window, backport to private customers after QA.

amy-support: Noted. I’ll tell Acme: temp workaround (software wrap) now, rollback to prior adapter behavior within hours, full patch in 24-48h, will provide audit log slice and final RCA. They accepted the plan and asked for exact times.

lucas-eng-runtime: Deploy-bot: ``deploy-bot: triggered canary: runtime/keystore-rollback-20260304 -> us-east-1/canary by lucas-eng-runtime``

deploy-bot: Canary started: run id dpl_20260304_001. Health checks: 0/5 failing so far.

jon-oncall: Please post the monitoring dashboard link once canary is live. Also post the command I can run to flip tenant flag if we need manual fallback.

lucas-eng-runtime: Tenant flag flip CLI:```
redwoodctl tenant update acmepay --set allow_software_wrap=true
```

miguel-eng-security: For patch prioritization: mark CVE-2026-12345 as P0 internal, assign to eng-runtime + eng-security, target PR by EOD tomorrow, QA + staged roll 24-48h.

olivia-devex: I'll draft the customer note and migration steps. amy, sara — want me to send the note to Acme?

amy-support: Yes please. Include repro timeline, mitigation steps, and expected ETA for full patch. Also include contact for escalation (oncall).

customer-bot: Acme confirmed tenant override acceptance via support ticket #C-98321. They requested a firm ETA for full patch and audit log export.

jon-oncall: Copying plan to incident tracker. Will update last_message_ts when rollback complete. For now, status = actioning. :eyes:
